changes: Chat can use your attached conversation as the target for requested title or summary corrections and explain when an edit cannot be made.
Omi can repair repeated mistakes and organize duplicate memories, people, tasks and captures, with Before/After context and Undo in Recent Changes

changes.change: On-device fallback transcription uses Apple’s newer speech engine on supported iPhones.
On-device fallback transcription decodes recordings in bounded chunks for better reliability.

changes: Less stutter when scrolling or switching pages while recordings sync, during long recordings, and after reopening the app
Saved conversations and memories waiting on your allowance link to usage without an upgrade prompt
Chat answers no longer show dead, unopenable source cards under responses — sources appear only as tappable conversation links again
A conversation that fails to delete now comes back in your list instead of staying hidden until the next refresh
A calmer Home: recordings still on their way show as one row in Today, and a new Activity bell collects your recaps and the changes Omi made for you
If Bluetooth is off or not allowed while connecting your Omi, Scan Again, How to Pair and Contact Support now still appear after a few seconds.
Recent changes now shows what actually changed, with the old and new text side by side, grouped by name, memory, task and title, and lets you undo every occurrence of a correction at once.
If checking off a task fails to save, the app now says so and keeps the task as it was instead of failing silently.
